name: Ring Schwartz
source:
Vogel's soldier and protector.  

He follows Darius's orders to a fault and is hostile toward anyone who threatens their goals, while also holding a genuine interest in you.  

But hiding behind his guard dog act is his surprisingly pure and cute nature, as well as the reason why he became Darius's puppet.

Organization: Vogel
Fairy Tale Curse: Swan Lake's Black Swan

[Official English in-game introduction]
